name: Áed Minbhrec
text: Áed Minbhrec appears in the mythic genealogy as one of the sons of the Dagda. He belongs to the divine kindred of the Tuatha Dé. MacKillop reads the form as one of the named divine sons. The principal record sits under the Dagda headword.

attributes.attribute: Son of the Dagda and member of the Tuatha Dé Danann

okr.objective: Áed Minbhrec is a MacKillop signpost to the Dagda.
key_results: Cites the Dagda as the canonical headword.
Member of the Tuatha Dé Danann.
